payload.title: Accept unresolved-action optimization completion
payload.description:
A portfolio optimization run that completes analysis but leaves advisory human actions unresolved must remain a valid completed run. The living-report finalizer currently rejects this terminal state and marks the run failed.

Feature: Preserve valid portfolio completion with unresolved actions

Scenario: Analysis completes with unresolved human actions
Given a portfolio optimization run has completed its exhaustive analysis
And one or more advisory human actions remain unresolved
When the living report is finalized with status COMPLETED_WITH_UNRESOLVED_ACTIONS
Then the Report and Task preserve a completed-with-unresolved-actions terminal state
And the run is not converted to failed
And the report identifies the unresolved actions as the next operator work

Scenario: Unknown terminal status remains fail-closed
Given a portfolio optimization run produces an unsupported terminal status
When the living report is finalized
Then finalization rejects the status
And the failure remains visible to operators

Exclusions: This repair does not approve actions, launch optimizers, mutate scores, or add data resources.
